5 4 40
Miss Juliette Chow Fee Teh(周斐德) or Julia Chow
alias Chow Chi Peh(周起白) alias Mrs. T.K. Chow(周子競).
It is said she is a native of Fukien, age about 30,
staying for the past two years in Apt 106, Empire Mansions,
153 Route de Say Zoong (Tel. 74556). Owns car, French
licence No.1303, said to have been presented to her by a
Portuguese friend who visits her frequently.
Her husband T.K. Chow was during the Nationalist
regime prior to the Sino-Japanese hostilities employed
in the Central Research Institute, 37 Brenan Road (now
defunct). He left her soon after the outbreak of war,
probably proceeding to Chungking. She then cohabited with
a German, name unknown, who after some 18 months departed
for Hongkong. She became intimate with an Italian said to
be connected with the Defense Force and after breaking
relations with him, she has been seen in the company of a
Portuguese. She left for Hongkong in August 1939,
returned in September, again departed for Hongkong in
October and returned in November 1939.
Like to t.

朱丽叶·周斐德小姐（Miss Juliette Chow Fee Teh，周斐德），又名朱莉娅·周（Julia Chow）
化名周起白（Chow Chi Peh），又名周子競夫人（Mrs. T.K. Chow）。
据称其为福建人，年龄约30岁，
过去两年居住于霞飞路153号帝国公寓106室（电话：74556）。拥有汽车一辆，
法国牌照第1303号，据称由一位经常拜访她的葡萄牙朋友赠送。
其丈夫T.K.周在中日敌对行动爆发前的国民政府时期，
受雇于布伦南路37号的中央研究院（现已停办）。战争爆发后不久他便离她而去，
可能前往重庆。随后她与一名德国人同居，姓名不详，该人在约18个月后前往香港。
之后她与一名据说与防卫部队有关的意大利人关系亲密，在与该意大利人断绝关系后，
有人见她与一名葡萄牙人在一起。她于1939年8月前往香港，
9月返回，10月再次前往香港，并于1939年11月返回。
同上。
